records.observation: Received Family Documentation is not the canonical component-family membership; Canonical/Baseline 1.0 are received declarations, not a successor approval.
records.proposal: Use Family/Component Document Identity, retain Type Architecture and original identity/path; explicitly preserve received provenance, cumulative evidenced authors and edition controls.

records.observation: Every document is said to have an exactly-one permanent identity without distinguishing in-scope normalized logical documents, excluded functional files, unassigned subjects or exact editions.
records.proposal: Limit applicability to assigned normalized logical documents; distinguish files, representations, edition coordinates and excluded files; preserve historical identity without guaranteeing availability.

records.observation: Identifier uniqueness is specified within a domain while Document Identity is called unique without defining qualified identity, canonical representation, domain allocation, namespace/non-overlap or authoritative resolution.
records.proposal: Specify qualified Domain+Identifier and canonical string under governing schema/allocator; make uniqueness and non-overlap assessed constraints, not global resolver guarantees.

records.observation: Three statuses Active/Archived/Deprecated are presented as architectural validity; peer lifecycle/state specifications distinguish Unassigned and other state vocabularies, while Identity Status is absent from the five-entity DID-003 model.
records.proposal: Preserve source state labels as received, distinguish identity-record state, document-edition status, lifecycle events and pre-allocation; propose reconciliation with DID-006/014 and DID-003/005 without inventing one universal state machine.

records.observation: References are made identity-owned and target existing identities, without differentiating document-targeting references, optional incoming multiplicity, other endpoint types, or exact-version/snapshot references.
records.proposal: Define typed reference/owner/target, optional 0..N incoming references where applicable, and exact-edition targeting/record evidence; distinguish relationship owner semantics from identity-key ownership.

records.observation: All element ownership is exclusively within Document Identity and every interaction unidirectional, potentially overriding Metadata/Relationships/Registry/Governance semantic ownership and hiding required consumer-provider graph conflicts. Governance is an area grouping Workflow, Policies, Reviews and Baselines in ARC-005, not a peer component.
records.proposal: Separate definition ownership from registries/metadata/relationship edge owners, dependencies and executors; reconcile actual source/consumer required graph with prohibition of dependency cycles.

records.observation: Immutable, permanent, deterministic, canonical and repository-independent qualities mix identity-key invariants with mutable status/reference records and unevidenced runtime guarantees.
records.proposal: Scope immutability to assigned identity key/association; permit governed changes to states/references, qualify migrations/non-reuse, canonical resolution and actual checks.

records.observation: Elements and architectural interactions are asserted as universal operational guarantees without explicit normative owner/source, check scope, permitted executor, evidence, or still-open peer/schema integration.
records.proposal: Make contract requirements distinguishable from implementation outcomes and approval; specify exact peer obligations and pending validation/propagation without inventing operational conformity.

records.observation: Two diagrams present identity references as a subordinate element without clearly marking concept versus mandatory schema fields or association directions.
records.proposal: Retain both views, add explicit scope/legend and association cardinalities subject to DID-003/005 peer reconciliation.

records.observation: Existing five element headings, five responsibility rows, five constraint subclauses, five ownership rows, six component interactions and three dependency IDs need traceable preservation.
records.proposal: Provide before/after map and verify headings/rows, real peer paths, cumulative provenance and exact source hash in UPDATE/VALIDATE.
